senses.en_definition: A colloquial spelling of lah, a particle used for emphasis, persuasion, reassurance, or to convey the speaker's tone.
Now; at present, in regional dialects such as those of Kedah and Kelantan.
A colloquial exclamation expressing surprise or puzzlement.

messages.en: I'm just about to head out, so I'll be a bit late. Sorry!
No worries, I'll wait here. Drive carefully, okay? Don't go too fast.

senses.en_definition: More; additional; further, indicating an added quantity or period of time.

collocations.en: two more days; in two days

senses.en_definition: Still, indicating continuation; with a negative, yet or any longer.
More; even more, indicating a greater degree or a comparison.
And; as well as, linking qualities or characteristics.
Used to reinforce a preceding statement, often in rhetorical or emphatic expressions.

collocations.en: all the more so; what are you waiting for? (depending on context)

messages.en: That rice we had earlier didn't seem like enough. I'm still hungry.
Me too. Shall we order another portion to share?
Sure, just one more. Otherwise we might not finish it all.

collocations.en: besides, we're already running short of time

messages.en: Shall we go out to eat?
Let's just eat at home. Besides, it's pouring now.

senses.en_definition: A song or musical composition, usually with lyrics.
The melody, rhythm, or intonation of the voice in reading, singing, or speaking.
A way, manner, style, or form.

messages.en: This song is so good! Have you heard it yet?
Not yet. Send me the link—I want to listen too.
